title: VersionSnapshot
description: Schema for an immutable map snapshot representing a building spatial and semantic graph

buildingId.description: Building identifier this snapshot belongs to

building.description: Building entity details at snapshot time

floor.description: Primary or single floor entity if applicable

nodes.description: All spatial graph nodes at snapshot time

edges.description: All spatial graph edges at snapshot time

semanticMetadata.description: All semantic metadata annotations associated with the entities at snapshot time
